# Vendored third-party code

`yue2/abc_tools.py` — copied from the YuE repository
(`skills/yue2-music/scripts/abc_tools.py`, https://github.com/m-a-p/YuE).
This is the only code the running server needs from the YuE checkout; it is
standard-library-only and is used for the ABC inspect/compare/strip-chords
services. The YuE repository checkout remains the source of truth — re-vendor
it if you update the checkout. See the YuE repository's LICENSE for terms.
